declared_mix.counterfactual_shape: per family x lang cell: K=2 -> 6 triples + 3 pairs; K=3 -> 6 triples; K=8 -> 6 triples. Triple = original + decisive variant (gold moves) + control paraphrase (gold stays). Pair = original + decisive variant (K=2 only).

diagnostic_set.banking77_k77: external hard-transfer diagnostic only, NOT the definition of success; ModernBERT-base-zeroshot-v2.0 is not clean transfer there (its published mix includes BANKING77)
diagnostic_set.note: authored diagnostic at K=20/77 in its own file; never averaged into the 70% target; BANKING77-77 stays as an additional external diagnostic
diagnostic_set.target_rule: the 70% target is measured on the 600 sealed cases (K=2/3/8) ONLY

eval_format_protocol: Same protocol as development: every compared model receives exactly ONE input format, fixed here before any measurement on this cut. Format derived from the episode-v1 comparative contract (data/episode_contract.py, COMPARATIVE_CONTEXT, predates both batteries): families with wants_context True (attribute_comparison, priority_decision) scored with the full candidate block in the premise; the rest scored one candidate at a time against an identical candidate context. The format is chosen without consulting this sealed cut, which stays unopened until #T-ce-confirm.

gold_rule.decisive: gold(decisive) = (gold(original) + step) mod K, step = 1 + (H(group, flip) mod (K-1)), so gold always moves
gold_rule.note: The rule fixes the SLOT before any prose exists; the author then writes facts that make that slot correct. Gold is never the author's judgement of finished text, and never rebalanced after a measurement.
gold_rule.original: gold(original) = H(group, orig) mod K, H = int(sha256('battery-sealed-gold-v1' + group + role))

namespace_rule: Sealed variant_group values MUST match ^sealed- and MUST NOT start with dev- or diag-. Zero variant_group shared with the development cut (asserted by test, not by comment). The diagnostic cut uses the diag- prefix.
note: Declared BEFORE authoring a single case (task: mix written and dated first). Any cut whose composition is adjusted after seeing a result no longer measures anything. Real distribution is checked against this file with the tolerance below.

overlap_rule.candidate_text: share of sealed candidate texts (normalised: lowercase, collapsed whitespace) appearing verbatim in the development cut; threshold: exactly 0
overlap_rule.declared_before_measuring: both thresholds above were written in this manifest on 2026-09-26 before a single sealed case was authored; the gate measures them, it does not negotiate them
overlap_rule.entity: entity-v1: lowercase alphabetic tokens of length >= 5 from the state field only, minus the STOPWORDS list in data/battery_sealed.py; entity_overlap = |sealed_types ∩ dev_types| / |sealed_types|; threshold: <= 0.35

scoring_weights.headline: macro over families (each family 1/5) on the 600 sealed K=2/3/8 cases; chance baseline per K written next to every figure; the K=20/77 diagnostic is reported in its own block and NEVER averaged in

sealed_rule.consumed_by: only #T-ce-confirm opens this cut, exactly once; the runner records the battery sha + a consumed flag and REFUSES a second open
sealed_rule.private_cut: hand-authored prose for this task only (no templates, no model calls); never produced by nor shown to any teacher; pre-training contamination is NOT claimed absent (not verifiable)

tolerance.cell_family_lang_k: exact match required (|delta| <= 0 read as pass; alarm threshold |delta| > 2)
